claims.statement: Pictelio is a single-engine Lynx client: the SolidJS + Capacitor WebView client (packages/app) was deleted and its Android Gradle host moved to packages/android-host (ADR-0203), and root bare commands dev/build/check/test/preview now all delegate to pictelio-app-lynx (ADR-0204).

The repository is a pnpm workspace (root plus packages/*); pictelio-app-lynx is the only application client and depends on six shared pure-logic workspace packages (@pictelio/update-check, ugoira, ranking-core, search-core, net-diagnostics, novel-export).

packages/app-lynx builds with @lynx-js/rspeedy via lynx.config.ts, which reads credentials.json5 fail-closed (__DEV__ requires PICTELIO_LYNX_DEV=1) and injects build-time constants (__CREDENTIALS__, __PUBLIC_CONFIG__, __APP_VERSION__, __BENCH_NAV__, __HOME_BLEED_HEADER__) plus the vue-lynx plugin options enableCSSSelector and enableIFR.

Workspace task orchestration and repository-wide lint/fmt are centralized on vite-plus 1.0.0-rc.0: root vite.config.ts is the single source for oxlint/oxfmt rules, and packages/app-lynx and packages/website are currently exempt from root lint/fmt (ADR-0185).

The Lynx boot sequence in index.ts is: import downloadExecutor/downloadSharer side-effect wiring, import styles/tailwind.css, createApp(App), then app.use(pinia), app.use(VueQueryPlugin, { queryClient }), app.use(router), and app.mount().

Routing uses official vue-router with createMemoryHistory (ADR-0138); routes declare meta.requiresAuth/backBehavior/topInset, the initial route is /discover for first-frame content, and 'can go back' is decided by a session mirror stack (_sessionStack) combined with a history-queue watchdog.

Client state uses Pinia setup stores behind a single createPinia() seam exported by stores/pinia.ts and installed in index.ts; the non-reactive watchlistStore and instance-level primitives (useSearch, createMixFeed, useComments, createGlobalFab) remain outside Pinia (ADR-0139/0140).

Server state uses TanStack Vue Query v5 with a global QueryClient (staleTime 0, gcTime 30s, retry false, keepPreviousData), a centralized queryKeys factory, and useApiQuery/useApiInfiniteQuery helpers with a generation-gate; the apiClient seam and its 401 single-flight lock stay unchanged (ADR-0141).

The Pixiv API client is dual-mode: web-core uses fetch plus the rspeedy proxy, while native LynxView forwards requests to the Java PictelioApiModule so JS never holds the access_token; both modes share the 401 single-flight lock, an auth-ready gate, and 429 rate-limit backoff.

The Lynx client follows Material Design 3 (static pre-generated palettes, appearanceClasses theme/dark-mode binding, and consolidated M3 components) instead of the deleted WebView client's Fluent/UnoCSS design system (ADR-0205-0212).

Internationalization is a hand-written message module (zh-CN source plus en) with a module-level locale ref and t(key, vars), chosen because the Lynx runtime has no Intl/vue-i18n support; apiErrorMessage renders messageKey with a raw message snapshot fallback.

packages/android-host is the Gradle build host that packages the rspeedy bundle into an APK and hosts the Lynx native modules (LynxActivity plus PictelioApi/Auth/App/SecureStorage/ImageService/Translate/WebDav/etc.) under android/app/src/lynx/java, with core Java services under android/app/src/main/java.
